answer: Silicon PUF attestation curbs Sybil attacks by requiring agents to generate challenge responses from unique nanoscale hardware variations. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital expense of acquiring discrete physical chips per identity. Whether telemetry nodes record a coastal gale, seismic shifts across a desert mesa, or water levels at a harbor jetty, authority stems from physical hardware. However, thermal noise can degrade response stability, causing false rejections of honest agents.
